notices.short_title: NYCHA Maritime Career Readiness Program RFEI
notices.description:
The New York City Economic Development Corporation (NYCEDC) is issuing a Request for Expressions of Interest (RFEI) to identify qualified organizations to design and deliver a NYCHA Maritime Career Readiness Program serving youth and young adults within public housing developments surrounding the Brooklyn Marine Terminal (BMT), including Red Hook Houses East and West, Gowanus Houses, and Wyckoff Gardens. The program is intended to connect residents to careers in the maritime, transportation, and logistics sectors while ensuring that communities most directly impacted by the redevelopment of the Brooklyn Marine Terminal benefit from emerging economic opportunities.  

NYCEDC is committed to fostering an inclusive and competitive economy for all New Yorkers, with a particular focus on equitable economic development. As part of this mission, NYCEDC seek…

notices.description:
The Department of Homeless Services is seeking appropriately qualified contractors/vendors to contract for the provision of shelter services for families with children, adult families, and single adults who are temporarily housed in DHS contracted commercial hotels. The selected vendors will provide services as outlined in this RFP to assist clients with their daily needs and to help them move out of the shelter system as quickly as possible.

The mission of DHS is to prevent homelessness when possible and to provide short-term emergency shelter for individuals and families who have no other housing options available. DHS primarily meets this goal by providing services to clients in long-term contracted purpose-built shelters throughout the City. When there are not enough available shelter beds and units in traditional shelters, DHS temporarily uses commercial hotels to house clients while they transition to permanent housing.  

Over the last 15 years, DHS has faced numerous crises which have forced DHS to rely on commercial hotels to temporarily house clients. Long term DHS is committed to phasing out the use of commercial hotels.  However, until such time that DHS…

notices.description:
The Office of the Deputy Mayor for Economic Justice ('DMEJ') invites eligible small construction businesses to apply for participation in the Centralized Construction Mentor Program (CCMP), established pursuant to Section 1309 of the New York City Charter and Chapter 24 of Title 43 of the Rules of the City of New York.

The Centralized Construction Mentor Program provides mentoring, technical assistance, and business development services to assist eligible small construction businesses in developing the capacity to compete for and successfully perform New York City public construction contracts. Participants may have opportunities to compete for designated construction contracts offered by participating City agencies. Construction work under designated contracts awarded by participating New York City agencies includes general construction and specialty construction trades.

notices.short_title: 84127Y0866-Request for Information (RFI) for E-Bike Battery Cabinets in NYC
notices.description:
The New York City Department of Transportation (NYC DOT) is releasing a Request for Information (RFI) to invite interested firms ('Respondents') to assist NYC DOT by providing information regarding the current state of the market for outdoor electric bike (e-bike) battery cabinets.

NYC DOT plans to support the expansion of outdoor e-bike battery cabinet infrastructure, in part by leveraging property the agency owns, including sidewalks and plazas; promoting the equitable expansion of e-bike battery charging and swapping services; and encouraging linkages between e-bike charging investments and the larger e-micromobility ecosystem, including shared mobility services and bike-friendly infrastructure.

This RFI is released through PASSPort, New York Citys online procurement portal, as an RFx. Responses to this RFI/RFx must be submitted via PASSPort. To access the RFI, vendors should visit the PASSPort …
